title: kargulstudio/sales-crm
why_read: An open-source sales CRM built in TypeScript, useful as a reference implementation but not technically novel.
analysis: This is a CRM application, a common and well-understood category of business software, built with TypeScript. There's no description indicating any unusual architecture, novel approach, or research angle that would distinguish it from the many existing open-source CRM projects. Its popularity may reflect practical usefulness for small businesses or developers wanting a self-hostable CRM rather than any technical innovation. It's a fine resource for someone needing a CRM template but not a technically exciting read for this digest's audience.
